summary: ANVISA Cruzamento Feature - All 10 features tested and PASSING. Backend: 11/11 tests passed. Frontend: All features verified via Playwright. The cruzamento endpoint takes 15-20 seconds but works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: VERIFIED: POST /api/anvisa/atualizar returns coletados > 0, processados > 0, and estatisticas with oportunidades_licitacao
VERIFIED: GET /api/anvisa/alertas returns alertas with SPECIFIC medicamento names (not N/A or Diversos), situacao, risco (ALTO/MEDIO/BAIXO), oportunidade (Importação/Licitação provável/Monitorar)
VERIFIED: POST /api/anvisa/cruzar-licitacoes returns cruzamento dict with medicine names as keys, each having licitacoes_encontradas count and licitacoes array
VERIFIED: resumo in cruzamento response has medicamentos_analisados (8), medicamentos_com_licitacao (3), total_licitacoes_encontradas (13)
VERIFIED: Frontend stats cards show Total Alertas (22), Risco Alto (9), Risco Médio (4), Importação (0), Licitação (9)
VERIFIED: 'Cruzar com Licitações' button is visible and clickable (data-testid='anvisa-cruzar-btn')
VERIFIED: After cruzamento, 'OPORTUNIDADES DETECTADAS' section appears showing 3 medicines with 12 matching tenders
VERIFIED: Table has 'Licitações' column showing green numbered badges for medicines with found tenders
VERIFIED: Clicking licitações badge expands row to show matching tenders inline with details (objeto, orgao, UF, modalidade, data)
VERIFIED: 'Buscar' button navigates to search tab and searches for medicine name
VERIFIED: 'Monitorar' button shows toast notification when clicked
seed_data_creation: Used existing 22 alerts in MongoDB from previous scrape run
context_for_next_testing_agent: ANVISA cruzamento feature fully tested. POST /api/anvisa/cruzar-licitacoes takes 15-20 seconds due to parallel PNCP queries for multiple medicines. Frontend uses sonner for toast notifications. All data-testid attributes are correctly implemented: tab-anvisa, anvisa-cruzar-btn, anvisa-atualizar-btn, anvisa-oportunidades, anvisa-alerta-{idx}, anvisa-licitacoes-{idx}, anvisa-licitacoes-expand-{idx}, anvisa-buscar-{idx}, anvisa-monitorar-{idx}.
